title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — June 2016–2025, Zegama (42.9758 N, 2.2903 W)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 42.9758 N, 2.2903 W, elevation 296 m, over the 300 June days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 23.6 °C and mean daily minimum 14.2 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 3.4 mm per day; 155 of the 300 June days (51.7%) had at least 1 mm.
These are reanalysis statistics for a grid cell, not official race data and not measurements from the race course or race day.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API，取 2016–2025 年 6 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 06 月后计算均值；坐标与海拔采用赛事镇中心。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 6 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 23.6，temperature_2m_min 均值 14.2。
precipitation_sum 均值 3.4 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 155/300 = 51.7%。
Open-Meteo 文档与页面标注数据为 ERA5 再分析；本页未把它写成赛事方数据或赛事日实测。
